newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SPECIAL S.AFRICAN BOND DEALS SEEN PHASED OUT SOON.
newsitem.headline: SPECIAL S.AFRICAN BOND DEALS SEEN PHASED OUT SOON.

text.p: Special bond deals available only to South African institutions could be phased out soon, Business Tonight television reported on Monday.
The move to phase out the practise known as "switching" was confirmed by the finance department, apparently in reaction to complaints by foreign investors excluded from following suit.

To entice institutions to buy stocks, they are allowed to switch their money into different funds without going through the market. The report said an estimated three billion rand ($625 million) went this route last month alone.
